verses.geez: ለብእሲት፡ ኄርት፡ ያበጽዕ፡ ምታ፡ ወይትመክዐብ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሕይወቱ።
verses.translation: Blessed is the man that hath a virtuous wife, for the number of his days shall be double.

translations.lxx: Blessed is the man that hath a virtuous wife, for the number of his days shall be double.
translations.ron: Fericit este bărbatul femeii celei bune şi numărul anilor lui îndoit este.
translations.grk: Γυναικὸς ἀγαθῆς μακάριος ὁ ἀνὴρ, καὶ ἀριθμὸς τῶν ἡμερῶν αὐτοῦ διπλάσιος.

verses.geez: ብእሲት፡ ዕብራዊት፡ ታስተፌሥሖ፡ ለምታ፡ ወይፌጽም፡ መዋዕሊሁ፡ በሰላም።
verses.translation: A virtuous woman rejoiceth her husband, and he shall fulfil the years of his life in peace.

translations.lxx: A virtuous woman rejoiceth her husband, and he shall fulfil the years of his life in peace.
translations.ron: Femeia vrednică înveseleşte pe bărbatul său şi anii lui îi va umple de pace.
translations.grk: Γυνὴ ἀνδρεία εὐφραίνει τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς, καὶ τὰ ἔτη αὐτοῦ πληρώσει ἐν εἰρήνῃ.

verses.geez: ብእሱት፡ ኄርት፡ ሠናይ፡ መክፈል[ት]፡ ወ[ት]በጽሖ፡ ለፈራሄ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውስተ፡ መክፈልቱ።
verses.translation: A good wife is a good portion, which shall be given in the portion of them that fear the Lord.

translations.lxx: A good wife is a good portion, which shall be given in the portion of them that fear the Lord.
translations.ron: Femeia bună este parte bună şi este dată câştig celor care se tem de Domnul.
translations.grk: Γυνὴ ἀγαθὴ μερὶς ἀγαθὴ, ἐν μερίδι φοβουμένων Κύριον δοθήσεται.

verses.geez: ለባዕልኒ፡ ወለነዳይኒ፡ ልቡ፡ ይሠኒ፡ ወለዝሉፉ፡ ብሩሀ፡ ይኩን፡ ገጽከ።
verses.translation: Whether a man be rich or poor, if he have a good heart toward the Lord, he shall at all times rejoice with a cheerful countenance.

translations.lxx: Whether a man be rich or poor, if he have a good heart toward the Lord, he shall at all times rejoice with a cheerful countenance.
translations.ron: Fie bogat, fie sărac, soţul ei are inima voioasă şi în toată vremea faţa veselă.
translations.grk: Πλουσίου δὲ καὶ πτωχοῦ καρδία ἀγαθὴ, ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ πρόσωπον ἱλαρόν.

verses.geez: እምእሉ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ደንገጸኒ፡ ልብየ፡ ወራብዕሰ፡ አፍርሀኒ፡ ገጽየ፡ ማዕሌተ፡ ሀገር፡ ወእንግልጋ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወስምዐ፡ ሐሰት፡ ላዕለ፡ ነፍስ፡ ዘያበጽሕ፡ ለሞት።
verses.translation: There be three things that mine heart feareth; and for the fourth I was sore afraid: the slander of a city, the gathering together of an unruly multitude, and a false accusation: all these are worse than death.

translations.lxx: There be three things that mine heart feareth; and for the fourth I was sore afraid: the slander of a city, the gathering together of an unruly multitude, and a false accusation: all these are worse than death.
translations.ron: De trei lucruri s-a temut inima mea şi de al patrulea mă înfricoşez:
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ τριῶν εὐλαβήθη ἡ καρδία μου, καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ τετάρτῳ προσώπῳ ἐδεήθην· διαβολὴν πόλεως, καὶ ἐκκλησίαν ὄχλου, καὶ καταψευσμὸν ὑπὲρ θάνατον, πάντα μοχθηρά.

verses.geez: ቊስል፡ ይእቲ፡ ለልብ፡ ወላሕ፡ ይእቲ፡ ለነፍስ፡ ብእሲት፡ እንተ፡ ታስተቃንእ፡ ከመ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ ልሳን፡ ትዔሪ፡ በኵሉ፡ እኩይ።
verses.translation: But a grief of heart and sorrow is a woman that is jealous over another woman, and a scourge of the tongue which communicateth with all.

translations.lxx: But a grief of heart and sorrow is a woman that is jealous over another woman, and a scourge of the tongue which communicateth with all.
translations.ron: De pâra cetăţii, de adunarea poporului şi de asuprirea mincinoasă; acestea toate sunt mai rele decât moartea.
translations.grk: Ἄλγος καρδίας καὶ πένθος γυνὴ ἀντίζηλος ἐπὶ γυναικὶ, καὶ μάστιξ γλώσσης πᾶσιν ἐπικοινωνοῦσα.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ አርዑተ፡ ብዕራ፡ ዘያንቀለቅል፡ ከማሁ፡ ብእሲት፡ እኪት፡ ወዘይነብር፡ ምስሌሃ፡ ከመ፡ ዘይፀብጥ፡ ዐቅረበ።
verses.translation: An evil wife is a yoke shaken to and fro: he that hath hold of her is as though he held a scorpion.

translations.lxx: An evil wife is a yoke shaken to and fro: he that hath hold of her is as though he held a scorpion.
translations.ron: Durere inimii şi jale este femeia geloasă asupra altei femei şi viciul limbii în toate se amestecă.
translations.grk: Βοοζύγιον σαλευόμενον γυνὴ πονηρὰ, ὁ κρατῶν αὐτῆς ὡς ὁ δρασσόμενος σκορπίου.

verses.geez: ዐቢይ፡ መንሱት፡ ይእቲ፡ ብእሲት፡ ሰካሪት፡ እንተ፡ ኢትክል፡ ኀፍረታ፡ ከዲነ።
verses.translation: A drunken woman and a gadder abroad causeth great anger, and she will not cover her own shame.

translations.lxx: A drunken woman and a gadder abroad causeth great anger, and she will not cover her own shame.
translations.ron: Ca boii care nu se potrivesc la jug este femeia rea; cel care o ţine pe ea este ca şi cel care prinde scorpie.
translations.grk: Ὀργὴ μεγάλη γυνὴ μέθυσος, καὶ ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτῆς οὐ συγκαλύψει.

verses.geez: ዝሙታ፡ ለብእሲት፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ እምአዕይንቲሃ፡ ወይትአመር፡ በቀራንብቲሃ።
verses.translation: The whoredom of a woman may be known in her haughty looks and eyelids.

translations.lxx: The whoredom of a woman may be known in her haughty looks and eyelids.
translations.ron: Urgie mare este femeia beţivă şi ruşinea sa nu o va acoperi nimic.
translations.grk: Πορνεία γυναικὸς ἐν μετεωρισμοῖς ὀφθαλμῶν, καὶ ἐν τοῖς βλεφάροις αὐτῆς γνωσθήσεται.

verses.geez: ወለወለትከኒ፡ አጽንዓ፡ ዐቂቦታ፡ ለእመ፡ ሥኅተት፡ ከመ፡ ኢታማስን፡ ርእሳ።
verses.translation: If thy daughter be shameless, keep her in straitly, lest she abuse herself through overmuch liberty.

translations.lxx: If thy daughter be shameless, keep her in straitly, lest she abuse herself through overmuch liberty.
translations.ron: Desfrânarea femeii în ridicarea ochilor şi în genele ei se cunoaşte.
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ θυγατρὶ ἀδιατρέπτῳ στερέωσον φυλακὴν, ἵνα μὴ εὑροῦσα ἄνεσιν ἑαυτῇ χρήσηται.

verses.geez: ወተዐቀብ፡ እምነ፡ ዐይነ፡[መ]ታሂ፤ከመ፡ ኢትግባእ፡ ትነስሕ፡ ለእመቦ፡ ዘብእሰከ።
verses.translation: Watch over an impudent eye: and marvel not if she trespass against thee.

translations.lxx: Watch over an impudent eye: and marvel not if she trespass against thee.
translations.ron: Peste fata cea fără de ruşine întăreşte paza, ca nu cumva, aflând prilej, să-şi împlinească pofta sa.
translations.grk: Ὀπίσω ἀναιδοῦς ὀφθαλμοῦ φύλαξαι, καὶ μὴ θαυμάσῃς ἐὰν εἰς σὲ πλημμελήσῃ·

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ይልሕስ፡ ጽሙእ፡ ወይሰቲ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ማይ፡ ዘቀርበ፡ ወያጸልል፡ ታሕተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዕፀው፡ ወከመ፡ ዘያወጽእ፡ አሕጻሁ፡ እምጕንጳሁ።
verses.translation: She will open her mouth, as a thirsty traveller when he hath found a fountain, and drink of every water near her: by every hedge will she sit down, and open her quiver against every arrow.

translations.lxx: She will open her mouth, as a thirsty traveller when he hath found a fountain, and drink of every water near her: by every hedge will she sit down, and open her quiver against every arrow.
translations.ron: De ochiul neruşinat fereşte-te şi nu te mira de-ţi va greşi.
translations.grk: Ὡς διψῶν ὁδοιπόρος τὸ στόμα ἀνοίγει, καὶ ἀπὸ παντὸς ὕδατος τοῦ σύνεγγυς πίεται, κατέναντι παντὸς πασσάλου καθήσεται, καὶ ἔναντι βέλους ἀνοίξει φαρέτραν.

verses.geez: ሞገሳ፡ ለብእሲት፡ ያስተፌሥሖ፡ ለምታ፡ ወጥበቢሃ፡ ያጠልሎ፡ ለአዕፅምቲሁ።
verses.translation: The grace of a wife delighteth her husband, and her discretion will fatten his bones.

translations.lxx: The grace of a wife delighteth her husband, and her discretion will fatten his bones.
translations.ron: Precum călătorul însetat îşi deschide gura şi bea din orice apă îi vine la îndemână,
translations.grk: Χάρις γυναικὸς τέρψει τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς, καὶ τὰ ὀστᾶ αὐτοῦ πιανεῖ ἡ ἐπιστήμη αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ፍቱ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ብእሲት፡ የዋህ፡ ወአልባቲ፡ መድሎተ፡ ነፍስ፡ ጠባብ።
verses.translation: A silent and loving woman is a gift of the Lord; and there is nothing so much worth as a mind well instructed.

translations.lxx: A silent and loving woman is a gift of the Lord; and there is nothing so much worth as a mind well instructed.
translations.ron: Aşa şi ea în preajma oricărui par va şedea şi înaintea săgeţii va deschide tolba.
translations.grk: Δόσις Κυρίου γυνὴ σιγηρὰ, καὶ οὐκ ἐστιν ἀντάλλαγμα πεπαιδευμένης ψυχῆς.

verses.geez: ሠናይት፡ በዲበ፡ በረከት፡ ብእሲት፡ ኀፋሪት፡ ወአልባቲ፡ ተውላጠ፡ ነፍስ፡ መስተዓግሥት።
verses.translation: A shamefaced and faithful woman is a double grace, and her continent mind cannot be valued.

translations.lxx: A shamefaced and faithful woman is a double grace, and her continent mind cannot be valued.
translations.ron: Harul femeii va veseli pe bărbatul ei şi oasele lui le va întări ştiinţa ei.
translations.grk: Χάρις ἐπὶ χάριτι γυνὴ αἰσχυντηρὰ, καὶ οὐκ ἔστι σταθμὸς πᾶς ἄξιος ἐγκρατοῦς ψυχῆς.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ፀሓይ፡ በውስተ፡ ሰማዩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ከማሁ፡ ላሕየ፡ ሥና፡ ለብእሲት፡ ኄርት፡ በውስተ፡ ትርሲተ፡ ቤታ።
verses.translation: As the sun when it ariseth in the high heaven; so is the beauty of a good wife in the ordering of her house.

translations.lxx: As the sun when it ariseth in the high heaven; so is the beauty of a good wife in the ordering of her house.
translations.ron: Darul Domnului este femeia tăcută şi femeia bine crescută nu are preţ pe pământ.
translations.grk: Ἥλιος ἀνατέλλων ἐν ὑψίστοις Κυρίου, καὶ κάλλος ἀγαθῆς γυναικὸς ἐν κόσμῳ οἰκίας αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ማኅቶተ፡ ቅድሳት፡ እንተ፡ ታበርህ፡ በዲበ፡ ተቅዋማ፡ ከማሁ፡ ላሕየ፡ ገጹ፡ ለጠቢብ፡ በሥነ፡ ግዕዙ።
verses.translation: As the clear light is upon the holy candlestick: so is the beauty of the face in ripe age.

translations.lxx: As the clear light is upon the holy candlestick: so is the beauty of the face in ripe age.
translations.ron: Dar peste dar este femeia ruşinoasă şi nici o comoară nu preţuieşte cât o femeie înfrânată.
translations.grk: Λύχνος ἐκλάμπων ἐπὶ λυχνίας ἁγίας, καὶ κάλλος προσώπου ἐπὶ ἡλικίᾳ στασίμῃ.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ አዕማደ፡ ወርቅ፡ እለ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ዲበ፡ ምክያደ፡ ብሩር፡ ከማሁ፡ በአተ፡ እገሪሁ፡ ለኄር፡ ዘይቀውም፡ በሠናይ።
verses.translation: As the golden pillars are upon the sockets of silver; so are the fair feet with a constant heart.

translations.lxx: As the golden pillars are upon the sockets of silver; so are the fair feet with a constant heart.
translations.ron: Soarele când răsare întru cele înalte ale Domnului şi frumuseţea femeii celei bune, podoabă este casei sale.
translations.grk: Στύλοι χρύσεοι ἐπὶ βάσεως ἀργυρᾶς, καὶ πόδες ὡραῖοι ἐπὶ στέρνοις εὐσταθοῦς.

verses.geez: በእሉ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ተከዘኒ፡ ልብየ፡ ወራብዖሙሰ፡ መዐተ፡ አምጽአ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ብእሲ፡ መስተቃትል፡(ወተባዕ፡)ሶበ፡ የኀጥእ፡ ወይጼነስ፡ ዕደው፡ ጠቢባን፡ ለእመ፡ ስሕቱ፡ ወዘየኀድጋ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ ወይገብእ፡ ውስተ፡ ኀጢአት፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ያወድቆ፡ በኵናት።
verses.translation: There be two things that grieve my heart; and the third maketh me angry: a man of war that suffereth poverty; and men of understanding that are not set by: and one that returneth from righteousness to sin; the Lord prepareth such an one for the sword.

translations.lxx: There be two things that grieve my heart; and the third maketh me angry: a man of war that suffereth poverty; and men of understanding that are not set by: and one that returneth from righteousness to sin; the Lord prepareth such an one for the sword.
translations.grk: Επὶ δυσὶ λελύπηται ἡ καρδία μου, καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ τρίτῳ θυμός μοι ἐπῆλθεν· ἀνὴρ πολεμιστὴς ὑστερῶν διʼ ἔνδειαν, καὶ ἄνδρες συνετοὶ ἐὰν σκυβαλισθῶσιν· ἐπανάγων ἀπὸ δικαιοσύνης ἐπὶ ἁμαρτίαν, ὁ Κύριος ἑτοιμάσει εἰς ῥομφαίαν αὐτόν.

verses.geez: እምዕጹብ፡ ይድኅን፡ ሠያጢ፡ እምኀጢአት፡ ወኢይጸድቅ፡ መያሲ፡ እምዐምፆት።
verses.translation: A merchant shall hardly keep himself from doing wrong; and an huckster shall not be freed from sin.

translations.lxx: A merchant shall hardly keep himself from doing wrong; and an huckster shall not be freed from sin.
translations.grk: Μόλις ἐξελεῖται ἔμπορος ἀπὸ πλημμελείας, καὶ οὐ δικαιωθήσεται κάπηλος ἀπὸ ἁμαρτίας.
